newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline falls $2 despite sales to the U.S..
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline falls $2 despite sales to the U.S..

text.p: NWE gasoline fell $2 a tonne on Thursday, despite support from the U.S. which has bought over 100,000 tonnes in recent days from Europe.
Rotterdam barges traded from $183.50 down to $180 before recovering late to talk $182.50 fob ARA for premium unleaded.
Cargoes were pegged around $195 cif Hamburg for 98 octane but demand into Germany has begun to falter in recent days.

Swaps also fell with trade at $184 for July and $185 for August. Despite demand from the U.S. and Nigeria some traders expected softer levels over the next few days. "In Europe right now there is just no demand," said one.
